id: title:adamleithp:match desktop grouping and row chrome in the quill chat

review.posthog_relevance: Adds status labeling, tool call recording, archive actions, title editing, and tool run summarization to the PostHog Desktop AI agent interface.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates several substantive, bounded improvements: P1.F25.H1 adds status and separator labels for the AI agent's conversation history; P1.F26.H1 records the kind of tool call and updates story examples; P1.F34.H3 changes the listener implementation for task updates and failures; P1.F37.H1 adds an Archive action; P1.F38.H1 adds title editing and loading states; P1.F47
review.uncertainty: Several hunks explicitly lack complete implementations or rely on missing chunks, preventing a definitive assessment of broader systemic impact or complete behavior realization. The score is assigned based on the demonstrated, complete hunks rather than the incomplete ones.
